pages.scan: I opened works/auto-6294ee8a2094/workflow/storyboards-unnumbered/page-06.png with Read and looked at it directly. It read without problems. The page has 4 panels: a top row with left and right panels, a wide middle panel and a large bottom panel. There are no speech balloons, only captions and teal labels.
pages.observation: My reading order: (1) Top-left panel. Caption 'Tomorrow, care may take us beyond our hometown.' with Ravi. (2) Top-right panel. Teal label 'WELBUK VISION', then the caption 'The vision: trusted connections between clinics, specialists, and patients across locations.' A specialist placeholder is shown. (3) Middle panel. Teal label 'WELBUK VISION' again, then the caption 'One connected ecosystem for care and family wellness.' Ravi, a partner and a child are shown. (4) Bottom panel. Meera, Ananya and Ravi, with the teal label 'Welbuk Practice • Welbuk Care • Welbuk Health' at top right covering Ravi's label, and at bottom left the caption 'Welbuk — Building a connected healthcare ecosystem.' The order is readable. Issues: (a) 'Tomorrow' is ambiguous: it could mean literally the next day or the future in general. The narrator behind 'us' / 'our hometown' is unclear (Ravi, the clinic, or the brand). (b) The specialist, partner and child appear with no introduction, so the time or place shift (future, other city, family) is not set up. (c) 'WELBUK VISION' is repeated in panels 2 and 3, and panel 2 also repeats 'The vision:'. (d) The whole page is narration and labels with no character dialogue or reaction, so the story ends as an advertisement rather than resolving Ravi's 'tired' complaint from page 4. That thread is never answered. (e) The bottom panel has a lot of empty space, and its label overlaps Ravi's placeholder. No reader-thanks message is present.
